scripts.local: dotenv -e .env.local -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'expo prebuild --clean --platform android && expo run:android'
scripts.local:pixel9: adb -s emulator-5556 install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb -s emulator-5556 reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb -s emulator-5556 shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "shoppinglist://expo-development-client/?url=http://127.0.0.1:8081"
scripts.local:pixel10: adb -s emulator-5558 install -r android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk && adb -s emulator-5558 reverse tcp:8081 tcp:8081 && adb -s emulator-5558 shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "shoppinglist://expo-development-client/?url=http://127.0.0.1:8081"
scripts.dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'expo prebuild --clean --platform android && expo run:android'
scripts.prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'expo prebuild --clean --platform android && expo run:android'
scripts.build:apk:dev: dotenv -e .env.development -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'BUILD_NUMBER=${APP_BUILD_NUMBER:-200}; export APP_BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER; expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./SL-Dev-${BUILD_NUMBER}-v1.0.0.apk'
scripts.build:apk:prod: dotenv -e .env.production -- cross-env EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1 sh -c 'BUILD_NUMBER=${APP_BUILD_NUMBER:-300}; export APP_BUILD_NUMBER=$BUILD_NUMBER; expo prebuild --clean --platform android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && cp android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk ./SL-Prod-${BUILD_NUMBER}-v1.0.0.apk'
scripts.env:check: PACKAGE=$(adb shell dumpsys activity activities | grep 'ResumedActivity:' | sed -E 's/.* u0 ([a-zA-Z0-9._]+)\/.*/\1/'); case "$PACKAGE" in com.anonymous.shoppinglist.local) ENV=Local;; com.anonymous.shoppinglist.dev) ENV=Dev;; com.anonymous.shoppinglist) ENV=Prod;; *) ENV=Unknown;; esac; echo "Environment : $ENV"; echo "Package     : $PACKAGE"
